name: Les Schwab Tire Center

nadir.desc: The property consists of several commercial buildings on a corner lot at N Central Ave|The main structures include a large white flat-roof building, a metal-roof bay building, and smaller flat-roof buildings near the street|Paved parking sits around the buildings|A large gravel lot occupies one side of the parcel|A railroad line runs along one edge of the site|Sidewalks and a crosswalk run along the public roads.

alpha.desc: The front of the site faces N Central Ave, with a sidewalk and a paved parking area between the road and the buildings|The white flat-roof building and the metal-roof bay building sit behind the street frontage|A smaller building with a dark roof sits near the corner|A large gravel lot extends behind the paved area|A railroad line and a row of trees run along the far edge of the parcel.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the white buildings and the metal-roof bay building, with paved parking in front of them|A large gravel lot occupies most of this side and extends to the railroad line|A smaller building and additional parking sit toward the street corner|No gates are visible along this edge.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows the white flat-roof buildings and the metal-roof bay building, with service bays facing the paved area|A large gravel lot with a looped drive occupies the ground beyond the buildings|A railroad line runs along the outer edge|Additional parking and a smaller building sit toward the street.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the street frontage, the metal-roof bay building with open service bays, and the smaller corner buildings|Paved parking wraps the buildings|A large gravel lot and a looped drive sit behind the paved area|Sidewalks and a crosswalk run along the public road|A railroad line is visible beyond the gravel lot.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from N Central Ave and the cross street into paved parking that wraps the buildings, and into a large gravel lot with a looped drive. The site is a tire and service center on a commercial corner beside a railroad line. Circulation space is open in the gravel lot and in the marked parking. The large, gravel covered open space on the lot would allow for staging and maneuvering on site. Service bays face the paved area and may be the primary work entrance. No gates are visible from the imagery. Neighboring commercial buildings occupy the surrounding block.
clarifications: Which door is the primary public entrance versus the service-bay entrance? Are any lot entrances restricted by gates or barriers after hours? Is there a designated fire lane through the paved area or the gravel lot? Is vehicle access available on the railroad side of the property? Are exterior doors and service bays secured by a lock or code outside business hours?
